questions.question_text: Banker's discount on ₹2000 for 3 months at 4%:
questions.explanation: Banker's discount equals simple interest on the face value. Using SI = (P × R × T)/100 where P = ₹2000, R = 4% p.a., and T = 3/12 years: BD = (2000 × 4 × 3/12)/100 = (2000 × 4 × 0.25)/100 = 2000/100 = ₹20.
